chunks: One of our companions, from Ibn Jamhour, from Muhammad ibn al-Qasim, from Ibn Abi Yafur, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
He said: 'Do not lie down in the bathhouse, for it melts the fat of the two kidneys.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reason given for not lying down in the bathhouse according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the physical posture of lying down in the bathhouse to the melting of kidney fat, reflecting the early Shia emphasis on *al-tibb al-nabawi* (Prophetic medicine) and holistic health. This advice underscores the scholarly tradition of integrating spiritual discipline with physical well-being, suggesting that modesty in posture preserves bodily integrity and prevents excessive depletion of vital humors.

en.hubeali:
One of our companions, from Ibn Jamhour, from Muhammad Bin Al Qasim, from Ibn Abu Yafour, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Do not lie down in the bathhouse, for it melts the fat of the kidneys’.
en.sarwar: 33. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said
the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘It is not harmful if one reads al-Quran in a bathhouse if he does it for the sake of Allah, but not to find out how his voice is.’”
